items.text: Adam Levitan agrees with Andy Reid that playing Kenneth Walker (groin) at less than 100% would be 'something stupid'; Chiefs are big home favorites vs Cardinals and have a huge Week 12 game at BUF, so expect caution and possible sit.
items.why: Reid comments on sore groin improving but not rushing; big upcoming schedule.
items.implication: Handcuff/backup gets volume; Walker owners need contingency.
items.opportunity: Emmett Johnson lead back role likely continues.

items.text: Brock Bowers (ankle/quad) DNP Wednesday and day-to-day after significant injury in Week 10; coach says progressing but may miss vs Broncos, boosting Michael Mayer.
items.why: Left Week 10 early with ankle; DNP Wed, coach 'significant' but not as bad as feared, can play without practice.
items.implication: TE1 risk; backup TE1 upside if out.

items.text: David Montgomery is off the injury report and fully expected to return for Texans TNF vs Colts; Woody Marks ruled out (concussion).
items.why: Full practice/no designation after groin; Marks out.
items.opportunity: Montgomery volume boost; reverse prior Marks beneficiaries.

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring) ruled out for Texans TNF vs Colts after DNP all week.
items.implication: HOU WR targets consolidate to others.

items.text: Buccaneers QB Baker Mayfield did not practice Wednesday due to a foot injury; trending toward missing Week 11 vs Lions with possible rookie start.
items.why: Foot injury, no practice Wednesday; coach comments on progress but Friday decision.
items.implication: Bucs offense downgrade; streamer QB needed if sits.

items.text: Matthew Berry ranks Chuba Hubbard as his RB6 rest-of-season and is fully in on him ('FULL CHUB(A)').
items.why: Strong production and role as lead back.
items.implication: Start/hold high; strong trade value ROS.
items.opportunity: Lead RB volume in CAR offense.

items.text: No IR for Jordan Addison per Vikings coach Kevin O’Connell after thumb surgery.
In first game with Kirk Cousins, Vikings set season-high Pass Rate Over Expectation; Kevin O'Connell clearly wants to throw a lot, boosting Justin Jefferson routes/targets.
items.why: Season-high PROE confirms pass-heavy intent with Cousins.
items.implication: Jefferson WR1 locked with elevated volume.

items.text: ETR notes NE loses Drake Maye potentially for the season (ankle); hard to find positives even with backups.
items.why: Ankle injury, pot season-ending; team-by-team notes negative on NE.
items.implication: NE offense collapse; related WRs/RBs downgrade.

items.text: ETR/Pat Thorman Week 11 Snaps & Pace: TEN@DAL up in pace; MIA@BUF slow slog; notes on DET/KC/MIN/TB/WAS matchups.
items.implication: Favor faster games for skill players.

items.text: Jaylen Waddle (concussion) was a full participant in Wednesday practice after bye; Berry still closing out due to production.
items.implication: Available but production fade per Berry.
items.conflict: Berry HATE on production vs full practice availability.

items.text: Matthew Berry is closing it out on Jaylen Waddle: nice target share but fantasy production has not been there.
items.why: Target share solid but production lagging.
items.implication: Sit or trade away; fade in lineups.

items.text: Lions placed EDGE Aidan Hutchinson on injured reserve and activated S Kerby Joseph from Reserve/PUP.
items.implication: Lions defense impact; Skattebo notes related celebration change.

items.text: ETR has Jonathan Taylor ahead of Chase Brown in ROS Top-150 half-PPR rankings (Brown further ahead in full-PPR).
